title.es: Mi año, trazado en el tiempo

es: Escribir un resumen de tu año con hechos anteriores a otros pasados, una situación actual y una previsión con future perfect o continuous (90–150 palabras).

teaching.en: I was proud to graduate in June, after I had been studying for four years.
teaching.es: Estaba orgulloso de graduarme en junio, tras haber estudiado durante cuatro años.
teaching.explanationEs: Had been + -ing presenta lo que duró antes del hecho principal.
segments: I was proud to graduate in June, after
I had been studying for four years.
teaching.audioText: I was proud to graduate in June, after I had been studying for four years.

teaching.en: By the time I got the interview, I had applied to ten places.
teaching.es: Cuando conseguí la entrevista, ya había presentado solicitudes en diez sitios.
teaching.explanationEs: By the time + pasado simple y had + participio ordenan dos hechos pasados.
segments: By the time I got the interview,
I had applied to ten places.
teaching.audioText: By the time I got the interview, I had applied to ten places.

teaching.en: Last spring I decided to apply to a small travel agency.
teaching.es: La primavera pasada decidí presentarme a una pequeña agencia de viajes.
teaching.explanationEs: El pasado simple cuenta cada hecho del año en orden.
segments: Last spring I decided to apply
teaching.audioText: Last spring I decided to apply to a small travel agency.

teaching.en: At the moment I am working there, and I am hoping for a promotion.
teaching.es: Ahora trabajo allí y espero un ascenso.
teaching.explanationEs: El presente continuo describe la situación actual.
segments: At the moment I am working there,
and I am hoping for a promotion.
teaching.audioText: At the moment I am working there, and I am hoping for a promotion.

teaching.en: By next June, I will have put half of my money into savings.
teaching.es: Para el próximo junio habré destinado la mitad de mi dinero a los ahorros.
teaching.explanationEs: By + fecha + will have + participio: lo que estará cumplido para esa fecha.
segments: By next June, I will have put
half of my money into savings.
teaching.audioText: By next June, I will have put half of my money into savings.

teaching.en: This time next year, I will be working abroad, and that is my goal.
teaching.es: Dentro de un año estaré trabajando en el extranjero, y ese es mi objetivo.
teaching.explanationEs: Will be + -ing presenta lo que estará en curso en un momento futuro.
segments: This time next year, I will be
working abroad, and that is my goal.
teaching.audioText: This time next year, I will be working abroad, and that is my goal.

prompt.es: ¿Cómo se cuenta el hecho anterior que duró cuatro años?

choices.text: She had been studying for four years.
She will have studied for four years.
She is studying for four years.

feedback.es: Un hecho anterior que duró hasta otro momento del pasado pide had been + -ing.

origin.text: Facts: Sara studied for four years. Then she graduated in June.

prompt.es: Completa: «Para el próximo junio habré ahorrado dinero.»

feedback.es: Will have + participio expresa algo que estará cumplido en una fecha futura.

origin.text: By next June, I will ___ saved some money.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase habla de algo que estará en curso dentro de un año?

choices.text: This time next year, I will have studied in Madrid.
This time next year, I will be studying in Madrid.
This time next year, I studied in Madrid.

feedback.es: Will be + -ing presenta una acción en curso en un momento futuro.

hint.es: En curso en un momento futuro: will be + -ing.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué ocurrió primero.

choices.text: He got a promotion.
He left the agency.
He worked at the agency for a year.

feedback.es: Had been working indica que trabajó durante un año antes de conseguir el ascenso.

origin.audio: I had been working at the agency for a year when I got my promotion.

prompt.es: Completa: «Ahora estoy trabajando en una agencia.»

feedback.es: El presente continuo (am working) describe la situación actual.

origin.text: Now I ___ working at an agency.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Para junio habré ahorrado bastante dinero.»

answer.text: By June I will have saved enough money
accepted: By June I will have saved enough money
I will have saved enough money by June

feedback.es: By + fecha + will have + participio presenta lo que estará cumplido.

prompt.es: Resume tu año: hechos pasados, situación actual y plan (90–150 palabras).

answer.text: Last year was a big year for me. I had been studying for four years when I graduated in June. By the time I got my first interview, I had applied to ten travel agencies. Finally, one of them offered me a job, and I started in September. Now I am working at the agency, and I am hoping for a promotion. I am also saving money, because I want to travel. By next June, I will have saved enough for a long trip, and I will have been working at the agency for almost a year. This time next year, I will be working abroad, and that is my main goal.
accepted: Last year was a big year for me. I had been studying for four years when I graduated in June. By the time I got my first interview, I had applied to ten travel agencies. Finally, one of them offered me a job, and I started in September. Now I am working at the agency, and I am hoping for a promotion. I am also saving money, because I want to travel. By next June, I will have saved enough for a long trip, and I will have been working at the agency for almost a year. This time next year, I will be working abroad, and that is my main goal.

My year has had three stages. First, I had been studying for four years, and I graduated in June. Before I got an interview, I had applied to ten agencies, but one of them finally said yes, and I started working in September. At the moment I am working at a travel agency, and I am hoping for a promotion. By the end of next June, I will have saved enough money for a trip, and I will have been working there for a year. This time next year, I will be working abroad, which is my goal.

feedback.es: El resumen combina had been + -ing para lo anterior, el pasado simple para los hechos, el presente continuo para hoy y will have / will be para el futuro.

origin.text: Datos: estudiaste cuatro años y te graduaste en junio; antes de conseguir una entrevista habías enviado solicitudes a diez agencias de viajes. Ahora trabajas en una agencia y esperas un ascenso. Para el próximo junio habrás ahorrado lo suficiente para un viaje, y dentro de un año estarás trabajando en el extranjero, que es tu objetivo.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige cuánto llevaba esperando Sara cuando empezó la entrevista.

choices.text: An hour.
Ten minutes.
All morning.

feedback.es: Had been waiting for an hour: la espera duró una hora hasta que empezó la entrevista.

origin.audio: By the time the interview started, Sara had been waiting for an hour. Eventually, they called her name.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase expresa lo que estará hecho en diciembre?

choices.text: By December, Leo saved a lot.
By December, Leo will have saved a lot.
By December, Leo is saving a lot.

feedback.es: By + fecha con will have + participio expresa lo cumplido en esa fecha.

origin.text: Plan: Leo starts saving in January and keeps saving until December.

prompt.es: Completa: «Dentro de un año estaré viviendo en otro país.»

feedback.es: Will be + -ing expresa una acción en curso en un momento futuro.

origin.text: This time next year, I ___ be living in another country.

prompt.es: ¿Qué forma marca el hecho anterior en el borrador?

choices.text: graduated
am working
had been studying

feedback.es: Had been studying es el hecho anterior y duradero; graduated y am working son el hecho principal y el presente.

origin.text: Draft: 'I graduated when I had been studying for four years. Now I am working at an agency.'

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué habrá hecho el hablante el año que viene.

choices.text: He will have finished his course.
He will have found a better job.
He will have lost his job.

feedback.es: Will have finished es lo cumplido; will be looking for describe lo que estará en curso.

origin.audio: By next year, I will have finished my course, and I will be looking for a better job.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Antes de la entrevista había enviado diez correos.»

answer.text: Before the interview I had sent ten emails
accepted: Before the interview I had sent ten emails
I had sent ten emails before the interview

feedback.es: Had + participio sitúa el envío antes de la entrevista.
